def main():
    import math
    MOD = 998244353
    n = int(input())
    d = math.floor(math.log10(n)) + 1
    power_of_10_d = pow(10, d, MOD)
    y = pow(power_of_10_d - 1, MOD - 2, MOD)
    ans = ((n % MOD) * (pow(power_of_10_d, n, MOD) - 1) * y) % MOD
